notes.title: Update #15: Trials, Chat and new content!
notes.notes:
Update #15: Trials, Chat and new content!

Hey folks! Hope you are ready for the holidays! We just added a bunch of great stuff to the game for this update! You can now play “Trials” (available in the main menu) in single-player mode and set your score! It gets to very challenging levels! Also there is a chat system in the game now that you can activate with the D-pad and send in-game messages to the other players! Hope you enjoy playing Havocado during the holidays!

<3
Webble Games

[h1]Update #14: New Tutorial, Ice Axe, Bug Fixes[/h1]

Hey folks! We have a free weekend this weekend so expect an influx of new players. Mostly bug fixes this patch but we did add a new tutorial at the start of the game and a sweet new melee weapon, the ice axe.

[/list]

[*] Invite-Only games should work properly now
[*] Fixed a bunch of non-networked props in various levels
[*] Fixed some weird sound bugs with music stopping and Mute enabling itself randomly
[*] Fixed issue where player gets stuck on a vehicle if another player grabs it

[list]
[*] In some rare circumstances invited players don’t notify the server when they are killed (exit and re-joining should fix this)

Have a nice weekend everyone!
<3

notes.title: Update #12: GUI Overhaul, Mouse Controls, Hyperspeed Tuning
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y2ausUT1CpB7IzFe0k/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey everybody!  The massive GUI update is live! We’ve completely redone the interface for creating and joining games of Havocado. This should make it easier to find a game to join and to generally get around in the game. 

We’re also trying a totally different tuning for the game: it’s fast fast fast!  You now automatically pick up weapons.  You also HUCK stuff when you drop it now. Anything can be a weapon if you throw it accurately.  We’ve added a dash move to the basic punch which helps to move around quickly and to dodge. We’ve also added a wall jump to make it easier to climb large structures and to make getting around easier. It’s pretty different. Let us know what you think!  

Also due to multiple requests we’ve added a mouse-centric control scheme. If you join as a keyboard and mouse player, your character now aims at a cursor and uses WASD to strafe and move.

<3 

-Webble

notes.title: Update #10: Burning and Breaking (PREVIEW!)
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/S407WR4RC3F3YK5vlA/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey all!   We’re ready to start rolling out two new, big, intertwined features: BURNING and BREAKING.  

Breakables
Our intention has always been to make the environments destroyable. For this first version, we’re using a hand authored approach.  That is, for each breakable object we design and build the broken version and hand tune it. This gives us a lot of control over how things break, though it is very time consuming. We’re investigating procedural mesh shattering but for now this method is stable, good for physics, and feels good. The main downside is time: it takes a while to authour broken versions of levels by hand. 

Burnables
Flammable objects have come to Havocado. This system is really neat; each burnable object has a Propagation Matrix that determines how fire spreads through the world.  This should lead to intuitive fire spreading throughout the level. We think it looks really cool! Leon has done a fantastic job authoring this system :). In addition, the player can now catch on fire. The player can also spread fire to other objects. The whole thing is a hilarious burning mess. We hope you enjoy it and find a bunch of new interactions we haven’t thought of yet. 

As we work our way through the levels, we’re maintaining a Burn and Break playlist with levels that are currently being worked on. This will be set by default when the game boots, but you can switch back to All Levels by changing the playlist. 

Note that this update is on the EXPERIMENTAL branch. We’ll push it to the main branch once it’s stable. Comment or hop on the Webble Games discord if you need help switching to this branch. 

Right Click Havocado in Steam and go to ‘Properties’
Click on the ‘Betas’ tab
Click the dropdown and select ‘Experimental’


<3 

-Webble

notes.title: Update #5 (Barge Level, Gravity Grenades, Crossbow)
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xkPLiGbrOlbiXfKipg/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey all! This week we have a level with a new dynamic we’re testing: the whole level can be steered and driven around like a vehicle. We’ve also added a special kind of grenade that creates a localized zero gravity field. As you do. 

We’ve also made some big improvements to character stability. The characters should recover from physics explosions a lot more gracefully, especially in the local version. We’re still working on the networked player, but this should still be a big improvement. This should make grabbing on to other players, pulling them around, and hanging off of them actually possible.  This was always the intention but we hadn’t figured out how to make it stable enough to really work. Now it does, and we think it adds a lot to the game. You can now pull and push other non-stunned players into fans and water. We’ve been having a lot of fun re-learning the game with all these new dynamics. Let us know what you think :). 

The secret puzzle in the Moon Pool level is now 90% functional. For those who found it already: great job! 

Get ready for the big update next week. KEVIN IS CLOSE. <3

-Webble

notes.title: Update #4 (SHARK LAUNCHER! Also climbing)
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/pyEVsvoZSev7ADER2t/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey all! This week we’ve also added a new gun: SHARK LAUNCHER. Pretty self explanatory, tbh. Just point and shoot. Then run. Probably best to run. 

We’ve also done an overhaul to the way that grabbing works that should make climbing better and easier. The player now maintains a list of all grabbable objects around them and tries to grab the nearest thing, sorted by importance. This means that you should be able to grab what you want a lot more naturally. For example, if you’re falling off a cliff, you should be able to grab on and save yourself a lot more often. 

There’s also two new secret in progress levels and another level involving flying drones. Enjoy! <3

Greetings from Webble Games! We are happy to post this update for Havocado with new features, content and fixes! Thank you all for playing Havocado and hope you are having fun! 

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]

Melee weapons now actually useful!  Press punch while holding to activate 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5biWGMAnMnBvklCSQr/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1]


[list]
[*] Added Whirlpool level

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/3f7e1a350430e86093a4342df2b0e2b27566d707.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3NhIO2SrHdaLhXTnTq/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Added Climbing tutorial level
[*] Added Pan melee weapon
[*] Added Hammer melee weapon

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/7ebc5572cc39188d99cc11ee163eea927d7abcd5.png[/img]

[*] Added P90 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/99df088cff78430abb5792b4dcdfca8398ac64a2.png[/img]

[*] Added MG

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/9b10cacc7b1cb111e03b3ecbc6fdf4ce93452952.png[/img]

[*] Added Double Barrel Pistol

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/e6620b64678f132fddf653704fc35d4339380b54.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1UTyStQ7zY1C4IHCCZ/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Added Cursed Lobster Treasure

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/66513591872b784f5de2a2b5cd9764dc9734828d.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/t6mnWZiDrG22NO9ejw/giphy.gif[/img]

[/list]

[h1][b]Tuning Changes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Stun cooldown timer reduced to 1 second 
[*] Minimum stun time increased slightly
[*] Controllable Sentry Turret overheats much more slowly
[*] Changed Backhoe, Tank, and Minisub to Accelerate when rotating (same as jet ski)
[/list]

[h1][b]Level Fixes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a hidden Sniper Rifle to Military - AllGuns level
[*] Added jetpacks in the stands of Boxing Ring for when players land there
[*] Added railings to Crusher level bottom
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Bomb shotgun bombs no longer collide with each other when spawning
[*] Fixed grab angle of held melee weapons
[*] Losing internet connection mid-game properly puts you in offline mode
[*] Mid game joining while others are loading new scene should now work
[*] Fixed playing without an internet connection
[/list]

Thanks for playing Havocado, have fun!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Players can now join in-progress games!
[*] Punching now aims for the head 
[*] Explosions now trigger other explosions
[*] Bullets now trigger explosives
[/list]

[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Jetski-themed level

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/f3db68b25e05d109e6e4abd1d75d67593fa4ded2.png[/img]

[*] Added a secret moonbase level

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/ef051bc56f54d4b367f768438efff9c75925925b.png[/img]

[*] Added Bomb Shotgun

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/1dae5bb5be4e0878ee5ae9f8c9d03455454ac790.png[/img]

[*] Added Laser Rifle

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259848/a939e1b830b3cd8897490e735b9c16709f517840.png[/img]

[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug: Saved audio preferences should now reload on game start (previously had to open the pause menu to restore saved settings)
[*] Bug: Turkeyshark’s turkey did not make a sound when spawning
[*] Lowered the volume for a lot of annoying sounds
[*] Bug: Fan sound in big fan levels now respects volume settings
[*] Fixed lighting in Manual Airlocks level for lower quality settings
[*] Added BuildID and some other stuff to Feedback Form
[*] Bug: Fixed some issues with playlist not syncing across the network
[*] Improved throwing of stunned network players
[*] Bug: fixed Space Race camera not following after launch in some cases
[/list]

[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1]
[*] Mid-game joining while transitioning between levels breaks
